name: hcapp_setEventNotes
description: The hasher's own notes on a run (E3.F4.S5). Writes Notes (blank clears it, trimmed) and optionally NotesVisibility on the caller's own HasherEventMap row for @eventId, then hands the changed row back through hcapp_syncUserData so every device they own sees it. The row must already exist — notes belong to a run they RSVPed to, attended or tracked (errorCode 1200 otherwise); where a hasher has several rows on the run the one with the highest AttendenceState is written. Auth: device-bound token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 100, @param NULL); the caller's own row only, no permission gate. Blank test is LEN()-based so an emoji-only note survives the SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS collation (2026-09-19).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The run. No SQL default; NULL finds no row and is refused with 1200.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Up to 4000 characters (the column width); NULL or blank clears. Trimmed. No SQL default — the client must pass it (NULL is fine) or the call fails before the SP runs.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: The app's HEM sync watermark, passed to hcapp_syncUserData as-is (NOT coalesced to 'ignore' here). No SQL default.

parameters.name: notesVisibility
parameters.description: 0 private, 1 shared with the kennel and the web; NULL (the default) or any other value keeps the stored value. Shared is effective only while neither admin override is set (HasherKennelMap.KennelStanding & 0x1000, Hasher.Preferences & 0x2000).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always first. {success, errorCode, errorType}: success 0 with errorCode/errorType on auth failure (ValidateAppAuth codes), 1200/12 when the hasher has no row on the run, 1900/19 from the CATCH; success 1 with NULLs on success.
On failure only, after the envelope: auth failure (detail from ValidateAppAuth), 1200 'Not on this run' (errorType 12, logged with eventId), 1900 'Unexpected error' (errorType 19, CATCH, logged).

rowsets.name: syncUserData
rowsets.description: On success: the rowsets of HC6.hcapp_syncUserData (HEM watermark passed through; hashers, HKM and narrow events 'ignore'; @usePaging 0). See that contract.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET Notes, NotesVisibility (when 0/1), updatedAt = GETDATE() WHERE id = @hemId (lines 91-95, transacted) — the updatedAt move re-syncs the row to the owner's devices.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog (with eventId) on the no-row refusal (line 78) and in the CATCH (line 101).
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncUserData after the commit (line 114), outside the TRY.

codeSmells.detail: Lines 2-6: @deviceId, @accessToken, @eventId, @notes and @hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter have no SQL default. A client that omits any of them (e.g. sends no @notes when clearing) gets 'expects parameter @x, which was not supplied' before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row. Give each a default (= NULL) and keep the in-body checks.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
